title: Kill memory-hogging process with SysRq
summary: Use the OOM killer via SysRq to terminate a process that is consuming too much memory and making the system unresponsive.
prerequisites: SysRq must be enabled (see 'Enable full SysRq key functionality').

steps.explain: Press Alt+SysRq+f. This invokes the OOM killer, which selects and kills a non-vital process using the most memory.
steps.gui: Hold Alt, press Print Screen/SysRq, then press F.

rollback.explain: There is no rollback for killing a process. You may need to restart the affected application.

warnings: The OOM killer uses heuristics and may kill an unexpected process. Use with caution.
This does not guarantee the system will become responsive immediately.
